page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g8a.4xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 16 dedicated physical cores and 16 vCPUs using the x86_64 architecture, driven by an AMD EPYC 9T24 processor operating at 2.7 GHz. The hardware configuration includes 64.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of RAM per core. This instance does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, and it provides a baseline network bandwidth of 7 Gbps.

In benchmark evaluations, the instance demonstrates strong single-core performance, scoring in the top 25% for stress-ng single-core CPU tests and Geekbench single-core metrics, alongside high text processing efficiency. Multi-core performance, software compilation, and database operations fall within the average range. However, a notable performance tradeoff is observed in memory bandwidth, where read-only operations on large, potentially uncached blocks perform in the bottom 25%, despite average performance on cached small-block reads and large-block writes.

Given its dedicated CPU allocation and balanced resource density, the ecs.g8a.4xlarge offers stable performance for general-purpose workloads. It is well-suited for applications such as web serving, software compilation, and database operations that do not require local NVMe storage or GPU acceleration. The instance provides a cost-efficient profile for workloads requiring dedicated AMD EPYC processing power without the premium associated with memory-optimized or storage-optimized hardware classes.
